description: Fig. 4a recompute (ten-target docking (single seed), single seed 20260210): one row per ligand that has >=2 successfully docked microstates, giving the within-ligand spread of empirical best Vina scores across its microstates (the 'swing') and the comparison between the default (single-strategy) microstate and the best microstate.
row_grain: per ligand (rankable ligand: >=2 docked microstates with an empirical Vina score)

columns.name: ligand_id
columns.description: MicrostateLedger compound id (cid) from fig3_run019_rows.csv; unique across the 391 rows.

columns.name: target
columns.description: DUD-E target of the ligand, taken from the first docked microstate's target in fig3_prior_empirical_scatter.csv.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Class label from fig3_run019_rows.csv: 1 = DUD-E active (99 rows), 0 = decoy (292 rows).

columns.name: n_microstates
columns.description: Number of the ligand's candidate microstates (union over strategies) that have an empirical Vina score; always >=2 by the rankable definition.

columns.name: vina_min
columns.description: Most favourable (lowest) empirical_best_vina among the ligand's docked microstates.

columns.name: vina_max
columns.description: Least favourable (highest) empirical_best_vina among the ligand's docked microstates.

columns.name: swing
columns.description: vina_max - vina_min rounded to 4 decimals; the within-ligand microstate swing (0.01-3.632 here).

columns.name: std
columns.description: Population standard deviation (ddof=0) of the ligand's microstate Vina scores, 4 decimals.

columns.name: vina_default
columns.description: Empirical Vina score of the default microstate = first candidate of the 'single' strategy (ORDER BY ABS(formal_charge), microstate_id); present for all 391 rows.

columns.name: vina_best
columns.description: Empirical Vina score of the best microstate (argmin); equals vina_min in every row by construction.

columns.name: best_default_gain
columns.description: vina_default - vina_best (>=0): how much the best microstate improves on the default; 0 when they coincide.

columns.name: default_mid
columns.description: Microstate id of the default (single-strategy) microstate.

columns.name: best_mid
columns.description: Microstate id of the best-scoring microstate.

columns.name: best_ne_default
columns.description: 1 if best_mid != default_mid (323 of 391 rows = 82.61%), else 0.

obabel.environment_yml: openbabel=3.1.1 (env/environment.yml L111); binary self-reports 3.1.0 -- both recorded as found

extra.n_boot_note: n_boot=10000 applies only to the bootstrap CI of the swing median (one call, swing_signal.py:136); resampling unit = rankable ligand (391 swing values, iid draw with replacement, target clustering ignored); n_perm=null: scipy mannwhitneyu default (no resampling)
extra.seed_note: seed 20260702 only drives the bootstrap in the summary JSON; the rows of this table are deterministic

null_fields_explained.n_boot: the bootstrap only feeds the summary JSON, not the rows of this table
null_fields_explained.n_perm: no permutation test in the producing script
